capabilities: Fix column widths by dragging, typing a value, or in one click
Apply background and text colours to a cell, row, column or selected block
Edit a common colour palette and reuse recent colours
Store styles as hidden comments inside each cell
Adjust column widths in Reading view
extras: Not yet in the community plugin list; install by copying files into the plugins folder or via BRAT. Styles are hidden comments, so tables still render normally without the plugin.
problem: Markdown tables cannot set column widths or cell colours, so columns are sized automatically and cells cannot be visually marked.

relations.evidence: The idea of keeping table data inside the note itself comes from Advanced Tables by Tony Grosinger.

summary: Markdown table plugin that fixes column widths by dragging and applies background and text colours to cells, rows or columns.
